title: Review and create one timed Google Calendar event
description: Prepare the new-event editor, review and approve Save, then verify the event on the displayed week.

steps.label: Prepare and check the event editor
steps.description: Start in an account-scoped Calendar tab. Enter the exact values as Google Calendar displays them.

start-date.label: Start date as shown in Google Calendar

end-date.label: End date as shown in Google Calendar

start-time.label: Start time as shown in Google Calendar

end-time.label: End time as shown in Google Calendar

steps.label: Approve and press Save
steps.description: Review the calendar destination and the filled title, dates, times, location, and all-day setting in the open editor before approving.

steps.label: Verify the event on the displayed week
steps.description: Open the week containing the event, then enter the exact event accessibility label shown by the read-week recipe. If the event is missing, inspect Calendar before retrying Save.
